entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Harish Sharma- Pp for the State.
Shri Dinesh Singh Tomar- Advocate for complainant.

Applicant has filed this first bail application u/S.483 of BNSS 2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.66 of 2024 registered at Police Station Ambah, District Morena (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 307, 354, 376(d), 376(2)(d) and 302 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant has filed I.A.No.23050/2025, which is an application seeking interim bail for the period of 15 days on account of thirteenth day rights of his mother.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that mother of the the applicant has expired on 28.10.2025 and her thirteenth day rights (Terahvi) is scheduled to be held on 08.11.2025.

Therefore,
it is prayed that the applicant be released on interim bail for the period of 15 days so that he can participate in the thirteenth day rights of his mother.
After verification from the concerned Police Station, learned State counsel submits that thirteenth day right of the mother of the applicant is scheduled to be held on 08.11.2025.

Thus, looking to the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that thirteenth day right of the mother of the applicant is scheduled to be 2 MCRC-20170-2025 held on 08.11.2025, this Court deems it fit to grant interim bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, I.A. No.23050/2025 is allowed and it is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on interim bail for the period of 15 days on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial court.

The applicant shall positively surrender before the trial court concerned on 21.11.2025, failing which, the interim bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to this Court and the trial court shall be at liberty to take the applicant into custody forthwith.
This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant:-
